speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you mentioned a pruritic rash, fever, rhinorrhea, and headache; have you noticed any specific pattern to the rash, such as it appearing on your wrists or ankles, and have you recently traveled or been exposed to anyone with similar symptoms? REQUEST TEST: CBC, Liver_Function_Tests, Serology_for_Rickettsia_and_Viral_Panel.

speaker: Doctor
text: With your normal CBC and liver function tests, have you observed a rash on your palms or soles, and do you recall any mosquito or tick bites in the past month? REQUEST TEST: IgM_IgG_Echovirus, IgM_IgG_Rubella, IgM_IgG_Measles, IgM_IgG_Syphilis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since those viral serologies are also negative, have you noticed any joint pain or swelling, and can you describe the exact appearance of the rash, such as whether it is raised or flat? REQUEST TEST: ANA, Rheumatoid_Factor, ESR, CRP.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your inflammatory markers and autoimmune panels are also normal, have you noticed any abdominal pain, diarrhea, or a change in stool consistency alongside your rash? REQUEST TEST: Stool_Culture, Electrolytes, Liver_Function_Tests (repeat).

With all your infectious, autoimmune, and gastrointestinal tests coming back normal, have you experienced any recent stress, altered sleep patterns, or a change in your diet? REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone, Vitamin_D_Level.
